about: The dependency sources and license expressions `cargo xtask ci licenses` accepts, for the workspace's Cargo.lock and the CI browser fixture's (tools/xtask/ci-browser-fixture/Cargo.lock). Each expression is matched exactly as cargo metadata reports a dependency's `license` field. Reviewed for infra-m0.2 on 2026-10-14 against every dependency of both lockfiles; a new expression is added only after the same review.
source_review_dc_snz_3: Owner-requested fixed-revision dependency on DNA Kode MIT OxVba embedding API. Only this exact source is admitted; no JIT in the adapter. Other git sources remain refused.
